source_title: 8 Strongest Anime Characters Who Do Not Use Weapons
source_excerpt:

The anime landscape is filled with powerful characters who use unique weapons during combat, but there are also many who choose to fight bare-handed. Most of these characters simply don't require a weapon to do serious damage, and many are exceptional melee fighters.
The strongest anime characters who fight without weapons can usually defeat their opponent with a single punch or kick, especially when their attacks are amplified by enhanced or superhuman speed. One of these anime characters is an actual God, while another can take on God-tier threats with his bare fists. Many anime heroes fight without using weapons, but a few powerful villains also choose to fight without any additional aid.
8 Tsunade From Naruto Fights With Her Chakra-Enhanced Strength
Tsunade served as the Hidden Leaf Village's Fifth Hokage and is still considered the strongest medical ninja in the Naruto franchise. She can use various chakra natures and typically summons a gigantic slug named Katsuyu during combat. Katsuyu is mainly used for support, and although Tsunade can use ninjutsu techniques, she prefers to rely on taijutsu.
Tsunade possesses superhuman strength thanks to her genetics and masterful chakra control. As a result, her punches can break through a Susanoo's near-impenetrable armor. One of her fingers can send someone flying or create massive fissures in the ground. Thanks to her mastery of Mitotic Regeneration, Tsunade is essentially immortal during combat, which is why she is able to fight on the front lines.
7 Monkey D. Luffy From One Piece Relies on His Devil Fruit and Haki During Battle
one piece devil fruits counter to enel goro goro no mi Image via Toei Animation.
Luffy uses Gear 4 Boundman against Kaido during the Onigashima Raid in One Piece. Image via Toei Animation
Luffy uses his Gear 5 transformation against the Five Elders in One Piece. Image via Toei Animation.
Luffy is the main protagonist of One Piece and the captain of the Straw Hat Pirates. As a Yonko, he is now regarded as one of the most powerful pirates in history. Luffy is one of the few people in the world who can use all three types of Haki and their advanced applications. He can dodge incoming attacks with Observation Haki, while Armament Haki enhances his attacks and durability. Advanced Conqueror's Haki allows him to damage God-tier beings.
Luffy ate the Human-Human Fruit, Model: Nika, which may be the strongest God Devil Fruit . It transforms Luffy into Nika the Sun God, whose body is made of rubber. Luffy can stretch his body at incredible speeds, which is why he can launch high-speed melee barrages. He can inflate his limbs to gigantic sizes to crush enemies, and all his attacks can deal serious damage when imbued with Haki. Luffy has defeated many powerful enemies, and he has done so using only his fists and kicks.
6 Meruem From Hunter x Hunter Didn't Need Weapons Because He Was Bred to Be the World’s Strongest Creature
Meruem was the main antagonist of Hunter x Hunter 's acclaimed Chimera Ant Arc. He was bred to be the most powerful being in the world, and for a time, he was the strongest Nen user alive. Meruem gets stronger each time he eats another Nen user, which is problematic because he already possesses immense superhuman physical abilities.
All high-ranking Chimera Ants are stronger than ordinary humans, and Meruem could instantly kill them with a single swipe of his tail. Meruem fought Isaac Netero, the world's strongest Hunter, and tanked all of his Nen constructs' attacks. These attacks would normally crush another fighter, but Meruem only suffered a few scratches. If Meruem does not one-shot someone with his tail, he destroys them with his fists, but he may rip off some of their limbs in the process.
5 Akaza From Demon Slayer Is an Upper Moon Demon Who Utilizes Superhuman Martial Arts
Akaza held the rank of Upper Moon Three, meaning he was one of the strongest demons in Demon Slayer . Like other Upper Moon demons, Akaza has enhanced physical traits, and his regeneration abilities are so great that he can heal most injuries near-instantaneously. He is a master hand-to-hand fighter who specializes in Soryu Style, a bare-fisted martial arts style that targets an opponent's neck and weapon with swift and powerful strikes.
Akaza's Blood Demon Art is called Destructive Death, and it revolves around his martial arts style. He produces destructive shockwaves with his punches and kicks, which usually manifest as nigh-invisible air pressure or circular energy-like projections. These shockwaves can also be used as ranged attacks. This melee fighting style allowed Akaza to destroy one of the Demon Slayer Corps most talented Hashira.
4 All Might From My Hero Academia Did Not Need Weapons While He Wielded the One for All Quirk
All Might smiles while in his muscular form in My Hero Academia Image via Studio Bones
All Might prepares to use United States of Smash against a Nomu in My Hero Academia Image via Bones Studio
my hero academia strongest ultimate moves Image via studio Bones.
All Might was Japan's No. 1 Pro Hero for roughly three decades, making him one of the greatest and most respected Heroes in My Hero Academia . He was born Quirkless, but after meeting Nana Shimura, he became a God-Level Quirk user because she gave him the One For All Quirk. He could not use the Quirks of the previous users, but All Might still cultivated One For All to its full base-level potential.
One For All granted All Might superhuman strength, speed, reflexes, endurance, and durability. While he was an active Hero, he battled and defeated Villains using only his bare hands. In most cases, a single punch was enough to stop a Villain, but high-tier Villains like All For One required a 100% mega punch to the face to go down.
3 Yoruichi Shihoin From Bleach Relies Solely on Her Speed and Hand-To-Hand Combat Abilities
As the former Captain of Squad 2, Yoruichi is one of the strongest female Soul Reapers of all time. Shunpo is a high-speed movement technique that allows Soul Reapers to move faster than the eye can see, and Yoruichi mastered it to the point that she might be the fastest character in Bleach . She is also a master hand-to-hand fighter who utilizes powerful kicks.
Like most Soul Reaper Captains, Yoruichi possesses a Zanpakuto, and she has achieved both Shikai and Bankai, but she has never used her sword during combat. She prefers to rely on her speed and martial arts skills. Her Shunko forms combine Kido with her fighting style, which is why she can launch high-speed melee attacks that can overwhelm other Captain-level opponents.
2 Saitama From One-Punch Man Can Destroy Any Opponent With His Fists
Saitama does not seem all that impressed with Genos in One Punch Man Image via Madhouse
Saitama fighting the Subterranean King in One-Punch Man Image via Madhoue
Saitama punches Boros in the chest in One Punch Man Image via Madhouse
Many anime fans believe that Saitama from One-Punch Man is the strongest anime character of all time. He might have a goofy appearance, but he possesses unimaginable superhuman strength, speed, durability, and reflexes. Saitama has fought beings who can wipe out entire cities and walked away with barely any scratches.
As the name of the series suggests, Saitama has the power to defeat anyone with a single punch. There have been times when someone has survived being punched, but that was only because Saitama held back. Most of the time, his fists instantly obliterate an opponent. With fists that powerful, he has no need to wield weapons.
1 Zeno From Dragon Ball Super Does Not Need Weapons to Destroy Everything in Existence
Zeno may look like a harmless child, but he is actually the Omni-King, the supreme ruler of the Dragon Ball multiverse. Unlike most of the characters in the franchise, Zeno is not a fighter, but he is still the strongest and most dangerous being in existence. Destroyer Gods become frightened children in his presence, and Angels treat him with the utmost respect.
Zeno is the only being who can use Erase, an ability which makes him the most powerful God in shonen anime . At most, Zeno needs to create a pair of energy spheres, and he can wipe out an entire universe instantly. He once used this power to erase six universes at once. The power to reduce universes to a state of nothingness is greater than any physical weapon.
